overview.title: Overview
overview.attentionMeta_one: 1 thing needs you. Everything else keeps running.
overview.attentionMeta_other: {{count}} things need you. Everything else keeps running.
overview.pausedMeta: All input folders are paused. New images wait in the folders.
overview.emptyText: Choose the folder where your microscope saves images. MiViA analyzes each new image and saves the report. Images are never moved or deleted.
overview.emptyHint: Single images: right-click them in Explorer and choose Analyze with MiViA.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.folderNotFound: The folder was moved or renamed. Settings are kept.
attention.reportNotSaved: The report is ready but not saved. It is kept.
attention.reportFailed: The report could not be created. The results are kept.
attention.reportStale: A report does not include the latest results.
attention.networkMissing: Network folder not reachable. MiViA has not reached {{path}} for {{minutes}} minutes. Check the network or VPN connection. Your images and settings are not lost.
attention.watchedElsewhere: This folder is also watched by MiViA Desktop on “{{machine}}” (“{{user}}”). Images are analyzed twice and reports saved twice. Pause the folder on one PC.

networkBlocked.title: The network has blocked MiViA since {{time}}.
networkBlocked.proxyAuth: Your network requires a proxy sign-in that MiViA Desktop does not support. Your images are safe. Ask your IT to allow {{host}} without proxy sign-in.
networkBlocked.tls: The secure connection to {{host}} could not be verified (certificate issued by “{{issuer}}”). If your company inspects HTTPS traffic, IT must install its root certificate in Windows or exempt {{host}}. Your images are safe.
networkBlocked.tlsNoIssuer: The secure connection to {{host}} could not be verified. If your company inspects HTTPS traffic, IT must install its root certificate in Windows or exempt {{host}}. Your images are safe.
networkBlocked.proxyRefused: Your network’s proxy refuses connections to {{host}}. Your images are safe. Ask your IT to allow {{host}}.
networkBlocked.redirect: This network needs a sign-in first (for example guest Wi-Fi). Open a web page in your browser and sign in. Your images are safe.

hold.continues: Images are safe and continue automatically.

history.customEmptyText: Select image series in History and choose Create custom report.

singleImages.emptyText: Images you send from Explorer appear here. Right-click images, choose Show more options, then Analyze with MiViA (Shift+F10 opens the full menu). You can also drag images into this window. More than 100 images? Send or drag the folder.

update.channelNote: Switching from Beta to Stable keeps the beta version until a newer stable version is released.

update.requiredText: It installs by itself as soon as it is available. Everything keeps working until then.

backup.title: History backup
backup.noFolder: Daily backups are kept on this PC only.
backup.restoreText: The current history is kept as a file next to it. Afterwards MiViA Desktop shows the history of the chosen backup.
backup.none: No backup yet. MiViA Desktop makes one each day.

privacy.telemetry: Optional: send technical and usage data to MiViA GmbH (app events, errors, timings, device facts, with a device ID) to find faults and improve the app. Off unless you turn it on; you can withdraw this at any time here.
privacy.telemetryNever: Never sent: images, file, folder and series names, results, search text, your access key.
privacy.offNote: While this is off, nothing is recorded or sent.
privacy.idsHelp: Quote these IDs to request access to or deletion of your data.
privacy.intro: Each event carries only the fields listed here. File, folder and series names, search text, results, images and your access key are never sent.
privacy.sentTitle: Data sent in the last 7 days
privacy.sentEmpty: Nothing was sent in the last 7 days.
privacy.serverAdds: On receipt the server adds the time, your license type and one-way codes for your account, organization, installation and device. The account and organization codes are removed after 90 days. Nothing is kept longer than 400 days.

support.title: Report a problem
support.descriptionHint: Optional. Do not enter confidential sample or customer names.
support.namesHint: They may identify people, samples or projects.
support.truncated: The oldest log lines were left out to keep the report under 10 MB.
support.disclosure: Sends the selected logs, system details and settings to MiViA GmbH support (no access key, no images, no results) and informs your MiViA contact person. Stored for 90 days. Covers all MiViA activity on this computer in the chosen period.
support.sendOff: Sending from the app is not available. Save the report and e-mail it to {{contact}}.
support.queued: No connection to MiViA right now. Report {{reference}} is sent automatically within the next 7 days.
support.notSent: Report {{reference}} could not be sent from the app. Save it and e-mail it to support.
support.saved: The report is in your Downloads folder. Attach it to the e-mail that opened.
support.deleteText: Deletes older log files, crash files and problem reports that were not sent yet. The current log file stays.
support.mustSave: Save it and e-mail it to support
support.policiesHelp: Set by your IT department through Group Policy. A setting that is not set uses the default.
